release.content: pubrel 0.3.0 was released on 2026-10-04 from commit 6173ec3e3a909c43908b3f42e90218975b5dad96 with these changes.

rows: release.json may list several `packages` -- a workspace and crates in it released with versions of their own -- each with its own unreleased list, package publet, changelog and tag prefix (`publet-core-v0.1.1`). add, next and prepare take --package; check, changelog and tag act on every package. A workspace bump leaves the pins of independently versioned crates alone, and their own releases pin their new versions in the workspace.

A sixth change category, `internal`: a code change nothing users run sees (a refactor, a crate moved). It satisfies check, never bumps the version, and is listed in the next release something else makes.
